16	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model;

18	import java.util.Map;
19	
20	/**
21	 * Fixed lookup of a city to its canonical region (locality).
22	 */
23	public final class CityRegions {
24	
25	    /** Region returned for any city that is not in the table. */
26	    public static final String UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN";
27	
28	    private static final Map<String, String> CITY_TO_REGION = Map.of(
29	        "Sydney", "NSW",
30	        "Melbourne", "VIC",
31	        "Brisbane", "QLD");
32	
33	    private CityRegions() {
34	    }
35	
36	    /**
37	     * Return the canonical region for the given city, or {@link #UNKNOWN} when
38	     * the city is not in the table.
39	     */
40	    public static String regionOf(String city) {
41	        return CITY_TO_REGION.getOrDefault(city, UNKNOWN);
42	    }
43	}

16	package org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model;
17	
18	import java.util.Map;
19	
20	/**
21	 * Fixed lookup of a region to its inclusive 4-digit postcode range.
22	 */
23	public final class RegionPostcodes {
24	
25	    private static final Map<String, int[]> REGION_TO_RANGE = Map.of(
26	        "NSW", new int[] {2000, 2099},
27	        "VIC", new int[] {3000, 3099},
28	        "QLD", new int[] {4000, 4099});
29	
30	    private RegionPostcodes() {
31	    }
32	
33	    /**
34	     * Return whether the given postcode is acceptable for the given region: {@code true} when the
35	     * region has no known range (any 4-digit postcode is allowed) or the postcode falls within the
36	     * region's inclusive range.
37	     *
38	     * @param region   the canonical region (see {@link CityRegions})
39	     * @param postcode the 4-digit postcode as an integer
40	     * @return {@code true} if the postcode is acceptable for the region
41	     */
42	    public static boolean isValidForRegion(String region, int postcode) {
43	        int[] range = REGION_TO_RANGE.get(region);
44	        return range == null || (postcode >= range[0] && postcode <= range[1]);
45	    }
46	}
